## Test TMDb API Connection

```{r test_tmdb}
# Search for Barbie (2023) using the TMDb API

response <- request("https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/movie") |>
  req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
  req_url_query(
    query = "Barbie",
    year = 2023
  ) |>
  req_perform()

# Convert the API response into an R list
movie_results <- resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)

# Display the matching movie titles and release dates
movie_results$results |>
  select(id, title, release_date) |>
  head(10)
```

## Build the Movie Candidate Pool

```{r candidate_pool_test}
# Retrieve one page of movie candidates from TMDb

pool_response <- request(
  "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/discover/movie"
) |>
  req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
  req_url_query(
    "primary_release_date.gte" = "2023-01-01",
    "primary_release_date.lte" = "2025-12-31",
    "with_release_type" = "2|3",
    "region" = "US",
    "sort_by" = "primary_release_date.asc",
    "page" = 1
  ) |>
  req_perform()

pool_data <- resp_body_json(
  pool_response,
  simplifyVector = TRUE
)

# Check number of matching pages and movies
data.frame(
  total_results = pool_data$total_results,
  total_pages = pool_data$total_pages
)

# Display first ten candidate movies
pool_data$results |>
  select(id, title, release_date) |>
  head(10)
```
```{r}

# Test retrieving multiple pages from TMDb

get_movie_page <- function(page_number) {

  response <- request(
    "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/discover/movie"
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_url_query(
      "primary_release_date.gte" = "2023-01-01",
      "primary_release_date.lte" = "2025-12-31",
      "with_release_type" = "2|3",
      "region" = "US",
      "sort_by" = "primary_release_date.asc",
      page = page_number
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  data <- resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)

  as_tibble(data$results) |>
    select(id, title, release_date)
}

# Start with five pages to test the workflow
test_pool <- purrr::map_dfr(1:5, get_movie_page)

# Check how many records we collected
nrow(test_pool)

# Preview the first ten movies
head(test_pool, 10)

# Check for duplicate TMDb movie IDs
sum(duplicated(test_pool$id))

```
```{r}

# Build a reproducible candidate pool for 2023–2025

get_year_page <- function(year, page_number) {

  response <- request(
    "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/discover/movie"
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_url_query(
      "primary_release_date.gte" = paste0(year, "-01-01"),
      "primary_release_date.lte" = paste0(year, "-12-31"),
      "with_release_type" = "2|3",
      "region" = "US",
      "sort_by" = "popularity.desc",
      "vote_count.gte" = 100,
      page = page_number
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  data <- resp_body_json(response, simplifyVector = TRUE)

  as_tibble(data$results) |>
    select(id, title, release_date)
}

# Retrieve 25 pages per year (maximum 500 per year)
candidate_pool <- purrr::map_dfr(
  2023:2025,
  function(year) {
    purrr::map_dfr(
      1:25,
      function(page) get_year_page(year, page) |>
        mutate(selection_year = year)
    )
  }
) |>
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Check number of movies in each year
candidate_pool |>
  count(selection_year)

# Check for duplicate TMDb IDs
sum(duplicated(candidate_pool$id))

```

```{r}

# Check U.S. theatrical release information

get_us_theatrical <- function(tmdb_id) {

  response <- request(
    paste0(
      "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/",
      tmdb_id,
      "/release_dates"
    )
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  release_data <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )

  # Find the U.S. release records
  us <- purrr::keep(
    release_data$results,
    function(x) identical(x$iso_3166_1, "US")
  )

  if (length(us) == 0) return(FALSE)

  # Types 2 and 3 represent limited/theatrical releases
  any(purrr::map_lgl(
    us[[1]]$release_dates,
    function(x) x$type %in% c(2, 3)
  ))
}

# Check all 15 selected movies
random_movies <- random_movies |>
  mutate(
    us_theatrical = purrr::map_lgl(id, get_us_theatrical)
  )

# Display the results
random_movies |>
  select(title, selection_year, us_theatrical)

# Count movies that pass
random_movies |>
  count(us_theatrical)

```

```{r}

# Verify U.S. theatrical releases within the assigned year
# TMDb release types 2 = limited theatrical, 3 = theatrical

get_us_theatrical_year <- function(tmdb_id, year) {

  response <- request(
    paste0(
      "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/",
      tmdb_id,
      "/release_dates"
    )
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  release_data <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = FALSE
  )

  us <- purrr::keep(
    release_data$results,
    function(x) identical(x$iso_3166_1, "US")
  )

  if (length(us) == 0) return(FALSE)

  dates <- us[[1]]$release_dates

  any(purrr::map_lgl(dates, function(x) {

    release_year <- substr(x$release_date, 1, 4)

    x$type %in% c(2, 3) &&
      release_year == as.character(year)

  }))
}

# Recheck our six previously qualifying movies
previously_eligible <- random_movies |>
  filter(us_theatrical == TRUE)

previously_eligible$correct_year <- purrr::map2_lgl(
  previously_eligible$id,
  previously_eligible$selection_year,
  get_us_theatrical_year
)

# Display results
previously_eligible |>
  select(title, selection_year, correct_year)

# Count movies that pass the stronger check
table(previously_eligible$correct_year)

```

```{r}

# Create a reproducible randomized replacement list

# Exclude all 15 movies from the original random draw
remaining_candidates <- candidate_pool |>
  filter(!id %in% random_movies$id)

# Use a separate fixed seed for replacement sampling
set.seed(402)

replacement_queue <- remaining_candidates |>
  group_by(selection_year) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(selection_year) |>
  mutate(replacement_order = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

# Check the number of available replacements per year
replacement_queue |>
  count(selection_year)

# Preview the first five replacement candidates per year
replacement_queue |>
  group_by(selection_year) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    title,
    selection_year,
    replacement_order
  )

```

```{r}

# Test the first 5 replacement candidates from each year

replacement_test <- replacement_queue |>
  group_by(selection_year) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  ungroup()

# Use the improved U.S. theatrical release check
replacement_test$correct_year <- purrr::map2_lgl(
  replacement_test$id,
  replacement_test$selection_year,
  get_us_theatrical_year
)

# Display eligibility results
replacement_test |>
  select(
    title,
    selection_year,
    replacement_order,
    correct_year
  )

# Count eligible replacements by year
replacement_test |>
  filter(correct_year == TRUE) |>
  count(selection_year)

```

```{r}

# Check the next five 2025 replacement candidates
# Continue after replacement orders 1 through 5

next_2025 <- replacement_queue |>
  filter(
    selection_year == 2025,
    replacement_order >= 6,
    replacement_order <= 10
  )

# Verify each movie's U.S. theatrical release year
next_2025$correct_year <- purrr::map2_lgl(
  next_2025$id,
  next_2025$selection_year,
  get_us_theatrical_year
)

# Display results in randomized order
next_2025 |>
  select(
    title,
    selection_year,
    replacement_order,
    correct_year
  )

```

```{r}

# Keep the 6 original movies that passed validation
original_valid <- previously_eligible |>
  filter(correct_year == TRUE) |>
  select(id, title, release_date, selection_year)

# Keep the first eligible replacements needed per year

# Select the required number of eligible replacements
# in their original randomized order

valid_replacements <- bind_rows(
  replacement_test,
  next_2025
) |>
  filter(correct_year == TRUE) |>
  arrange(selection_year, replacement_order) |>
  group_by(selection_year) |>
  mutate(
    replacement_rank = row_number(),
    replacements_needed = case_when(
      selection_year == 2023 ~ 2L,
      selection_year == 2024 ~ 4L,
      selection_year == 2025 ~ 3L
    )
  ) |>
  filter(replacement_rank <= replacements_needed) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(id, title, release_date, selection_year)


# Combine original movies and replacements
final_random_movies <- bind_rows(
  original_valid,
  valid_replacements
) |>
  arrange(selection_year, title) |>
  mutate(selection_method = "random")

# Validate the final sample
stopifnot(
  nrow(final_random_movies) == 15,
  !anyDuplicated(final_random_movies$id)
)

# Display all 15 movies
print(final_random_movies, n = 15)

# Save to your project folder
write.csv(
  final_random_movies,
  "data/processed/final_random_movies.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Confirm the file exists
file.exists("data/processed/final_random_movies.csv")

```

```{r}

# Five intentionally selected movies
intentional_movies <- tibble(
  title = c(
    "Barbie",
    "Oppenheimer",
    "Past Lives",
    "Dune: Part Two",
    "The Substance"
  ),
  selection_year = c(2023, 2023, 2023, 2024, 2024),
  selection_method = "intentional"
)

# Search TMDb for the correct movie IDs
search_movie <- function(title, year) {

# Resolve the verified ambiguous Past Lives match
if (title == "Past Lives" && year == 2023) {
  return(tibble(
    id = 666277L,
    release_date = "2023-06-02"
  ))
}

  response <- request(
    "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/movie"
  ) |>
    req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("TMDB_TOKEN")) |>
    req_url_query(
      query = title,
      year = year
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  results <- resp_body_json(
    response,
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )$results

  # Keep exact title and release-year matches
  matches <- results |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(
      title == !!title,
      substr(release_date, 1, 4) == as.character(year)
    )

  if (nrow(matches) != 1) {
    stop(paste("Review TMDb match for:", title))
  }

  matches |>
    select(id, release_date)
}

# Retrieve IDs for all five movies
intentional_matches <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  intentional_movies$title,
  intentional_movies$selection_year,
  search_movie
)

# Combine selections with verified IDs
intentional_movies <- bind_cols(
  intentional_movies,
  intentional_matches
)

# Display all five records
intentional_movies |>
  select(id, title, selection_year, release_date)

```

# Validate U.S. theatrical releases for intentional movies

# Display validation results
intentional_movies |>

```{r}

# Combine random and intentional pilot movies

movie_master <- bind_rows(
  final_random_movies |>
    select(id, title, selection_year, selection_method),
  intentional_movies |>
    select(id, title, selection_year, selection_method)
) |>
  arrange(selection_year, selection_method, title) |>
  mutate(
    movie_id = row_number(),
    tmdb_id = id,
    release_year = selection_year
  ) |>
  select(
    movie_id,
    tmdb_id,
    title,
    release_year,
    selection_method
  )

# Validate the master dataset
stopifnot(
  nrow(movie_master) == 20,
  !anyDuplicated(movie_master$movie_id),
  !anyDuplicated(movie_master$tmdb_id),
  sum(movie_master$selection_method == "random") == 15,
  sum(movie_master$selection_method == "intentional") == 5
)

# Display all 20 movies
print(movie_master, n = 20)

# Export using base R
write.csv(
  movie_master,
  "data/processed/movie_master.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Confirm the file exists
file.exists("data/processed/movie_master.csv")

```
